propositions: Plan reviews must maintain distinct compiled phase (planning|execution) in reducer state, updated only by winning STATUS target transitions into in_progress (execution) or open (planning), preserved on snapshot compaction and older-reducer replay.
A fixed 0.80 priority floor applies only to execution-phase attestations; planning-phase attestations preserve stricter original thresholds and accept legacy attestations without floor.

Phase compatibility enforces that execution-state tickets reject syntactically valid execution attestations with floor < 0.80 as incompatible, while planning-state tickets accept planning, legacy, or execution attestations with compatible floor.

Manifest and sidecar parsers must emit exact phase/floor tokens in fixed order (review-phase first, then priority-floor for execution only) with canonical grammar and reject every syntax/type/combination error through named validation helpers.

Signing must capture an immutable pre-LLM generation transaction (phase, priority_floor, own_material, relation_snapshot, ticket_store_revision) and enforce exact match under global lock, with at most three retries on unstable HEAD and terminal unsigned stale for any other stable generation change.

Failed-sign re-sign recovery must parse v2 JSON phase fields through sidecar parser, compare recorded phase/floor with current compiled state for compatibility, and refuse re-sign for incompatible or malformed variants while building manifest from recorded review-time values.
